censusV1Representation.openCounselQuestion: Which record governs the notarised verification on a Sec. 99-19-71(4) petition: the specification, which makes the jurat mandatory and calls the packet not filing-ready without it, or the legal-design intake memo, which records notarization as unresolved and prints a simple truth statement?
censusV1Representation.howTheOpenQuestionIsTreated: It does not resolve it. No verification block and no notarial certificate was added to the petition, the order or the certificate of service. The cover's signing-and-notarization page prints the SPECIFICATION's wording verbatim, because the specification is the server-owned document for this page, says on the page that it is printed from the specification, states that the composed petition carries a truth statement instead, and sends the participant to the records office of the court that heard the case - which is what the filing instructions already do.
censusV1Representation.grantsNothing: Rendering the specification's fifth document opens no commercial route, marks nothing proven and changes no live RCAP route. The counsel approval recorded above is bound to the Grade-A clinic artifact hashes and is untouched by this record.
